frontend_motion.name: intro_card_converge_and_scale_in
frontend_motion.note: First/center card scales from tiny to full while others hide behind it, per build prompt.

frontend_motion.name: fan_out_into_ring
frontend_motion.note: Remaining cards spread left/right from center onto the horizontal circle, forming front-large/back-small overlap.

frontend_motion.name: wheel_driven_ring_rotation
frontend_motion.note: wheel deltaY maps to group rotationY; on scroll stop, ring decays to rest smoothly. Cards continuously rescale and reorder overlap by depth.

frontend_motion.name: hover_zoom_highlight
frontend_motion.note: Cursor hovers over cards but no scale/elevation/highlight change observed across frames; not implemented in this build.

frontend_motion.name: drag_to_rotate
frontend_motion.note: Build prompt specifies 鼠标滚轮 only; no drag interaction present in keyframes.

interaction.feedback: ring_group_rotateY_incremental; per-card continuous scale and z-index reorder; smooth inertia decay after scroll ends
accessibility_notes: No keyboard arrow-key navigation observed in keyframes; wheel-only control is not keyboard-accessible.
No reduced-motion handling visible; auto/intro animation runs on load.
No focus-visible ring or aria-label on cards; cards are plain image planes.
interaction.evidence: Build prompt text in frame_30: 鼠标滚轮控制旋转方向和距离，运动平滑，停止滚动后缓缓停下，页面保持固定；图片随前后位置连续缩放，实时改变遮挡顺序。
